text: Honest evaluation is the focal equilibrium strategy in validation pools because validators who evaluate honestly have the highest probability of aligning with other honest validators, with staking and slashing supplying economic enforcement.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI's Mother's Instinct Engineered Consequence Emergent Ethics and the Institutional Trajectory Toward Agentic Alignment (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6244278
